messages:
anya: Quick Q for leadership during AH — why did we lose the FinAnalytics ROI pilot? They said latency spikes + lack of VPC were blockers. Sales needs a concise response and a playbook we can use in follow-ups. :thinking:
jamal: From the deal side — product fit was there, model outputs were fine. Main loss reasons: 1) unpredictable 99th% latency during large-batch ingest, 2) no private deployment option for EU compliance. They asked for an explicit migration path to Dedicated. Need a 1-pager for AEs.
cecilia: Customer quote: "Outputs looked great but the tail latency during their peak window made the integration risky. Also need data residency in EU." We haven't been surfacing Dedicated/Private timelines clearly in presales.
marco: Eng context: the tail spikes were tied to concurrent batch prep + KV cache warmups; infra autoscaling and private control-plane work are the gating items for Private. Short-term mitigation: we can offer manual reserved capacity + temporary SLA for pilots. Will follow up with concrete numbers.
tom: TL;DR action items I want: 1) AE playbook entry with mitigations + how to offer manual reserved capacity/burst; 2) VPC/onboarding checklist + ETA to share publicly; 3) add a concise "why we won/lost" slide to the sales kit. I'll allocate resources this quarter. For FinAnalytics specifically, @jamal get permission to offer a 2-week discounted Dedicated trial and collect logs/quotes.
anya: ETA on the VPC docs so AE's can cite dates? We can't promise features without timelines.
marco: Doc ETA: draft by EOD Fri, internal runbook (detailed steps + support contacts) by next Wed. I'll post the PR link here when ready.
deploy-bot: Incident note: https://internal.incidents/1234 — perf spike during ingest on 2026-02-15 (useful context for the latency ask)
cecilia: Also request Legal produce a short checklist for customers about data residency commitments. @anya can you own the ask?
anya: Yep, I'll ping Legal and loop @tom. Adding to follow-ups.
jamal: One more AE request — short competitor win/loss note on XCloud: was it solely price, or did they have integrations we lack? We need clear rebuttals in the playbook.
tom: Good call. Product Ops will produce a 1-pager by next Tue with root causes + suggested rebuttals. Action owners: @marco infra perf notes + mitigation steps, @cecilia customer quotes + exact wording, @jamal competitive intel, @anya consolidated sales materials.
anya: I'll consolidate and share a draft in #sales-playbooks for review. :thumbsup:
cecilia: Small product ask: can we add "acceptable latency ranges (P50/P95/P99)" to the model catalog page so AEs can quote numbers? Minor UI change but high impact.
marco: Filing ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/INF-789 — will link PR to the doc draft.
tom: Great thread — we'll present the proposed playbook in next week's all-hands follow-up. If anyone has more customer quotes or screenshots, please DM me and cc the thread.
